name: runpod
description: Official Runpod agent skills and MCP server — run Runpod tasks (pods, serverless, templates, volumes) with runpodctl and flash, plus conceptual guidance and worked golden paths.

interface.longDescription: Provision and manage Runpod GPU infrastructure, including pods, serverless endpoints, jobs, templates, volumes, registries, capacity, and billing. Bundled skills also guide runpodctl, Flash, image-building, migration, and troubleshooting workflows. The MCP tools manage Runpod infrastructure; SSH, local image builds, and file transfer use the documented CLI workflows instead.
